entries.reason: Confirmed via Russian Wikipedia and an archived snapshot of rosunimed.ru that 'Russian University of Medicine' is the current name of the institution formerly known as Moscow State University of Medicine and Dentistry (MSMSU/MSMSU n.a. A.I. Evdokimov). However, both the historic domain (msmsu.ru, redirects but then fails to load over HTTPS) and the current-name domain (rosunimed.ru) fail to connect live. The one available Wayback snapshot of rosunimed.ru (2024-02-24) confirms the correct current name in its page title but its internal template path is still literally '/local/templates/msmsu/', and no standalone logo file could be located even in that snapshot. Given the incomplete rebrand and inability to confirm a stable current-era asset, this remains an unresolved renamed-institution case rather than a simple missing-media gap — no media sourced, consistent with the standing guardrail against reusing another Moscow medical university's assets.
